title: Customer-Harm Surcharge on Wrong-Address Violations (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the customer-harm surcharge on a wrong-address violation follows the customer ratings given on the batch that carried the order.

**Clause.** When at least one rating on that batch is a 1-star rating, the surcharge is 2 points; when none is a 1-star rating and at least one is a 2-star or 3-star rating, it is 1 point; when the batch has no rating of 3 stars or fewer, it adds nothing.

## Truth table

| Any 1-star rating on the batch | Any 2-star or 3-star rating on the batch | Customer-harm surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | 2 points |
| No | Yes | 1 point |
| No | No | Nothing |

The ratings counted are the customer ratings the account received for orders on that batch; a batch with only 4-star and 5-star ratings, or with no rating at all, adds nothing.

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A Double Delivery Batch rated 1 star and 5 stars: 2 points.
- A Triple Delivery Batch rated 3, 2 and 5 stars: 1 point.
- A Single Delivery Batch never rated: nothing.
